title: K-Section, Botshabelo (map point approximate): five women and a two-year-old boy shot dead at a home, 18 Nov
summary: Five women and a two-year-old boy were shot dead and a 48-year-old woman was shot in the stomach when three men forced their way into a home in K-Section, Botshabelo, outside Bloemfontein, on the night of Wednesday 18 No...
story: Five women and a two-year-old boy were shot dead and a 48-year-old woman was shot in the stomach when three men forced their way into a home in K-Section, Botshabelo, outside Bloemfontein, on the night of Wednesday 18 November, Free State police said. Police say the men, two in balaclavas, first tried to get into a backyard hut housing female initiates, then demanded to see the male homeowner, who was not home, before forcing their way into the house and shooting. They fled on foot. Six murder cases and one of attempted murder were opened; no arrests were reported. The map point is approximate: the Botshabelo town point, not the home.
incident: Wed 18 Nov 2026, night, about 20:00 (police, via Sunday World and Insider Chronicle)
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. A home in K-Section, Botshabelo (Mangaung). K-Section is not in Nominatim, so the pin is the Botshabelo city point (-29.2324, 26.7333), never the home. Area level, about 4 km.

provenance.note: Both retell the police statement; Sunday World is national. Two different sites. Victims not named; a child is among them.
